description: Customizable Windows notch control center with quick settings, media controls, notifications, productivity tools, and system telemetry.
notes: Uses the official Electron Builder portable Windows executable, not the separate NSIS Setup executable. The v0.4.0 SHA-256 matches the GitHub Release asset digest.

The portable app bundles framework-dependent .NET 8 media-session and notification helpers. Install the .NET 8 Runtime separately if those helper-powered features do not start; Scoop does not run a vendor setup.
The upstream project notes that release binaries are not commercially code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show a warning. Verify the SHA-256 before running the file.
